title:
Overview of Switchover and
                Failover in a DG PDB Environment
content:
Oracle Data Guard broker
                enables you to reverse the roles of the source PDB and its designated target PDB
                using either a switchover or failover operation.

PDB switchover A planned role reversal between a source PDB and its
                                        designated target PDB. The broker ensures that the target
                                        PDB has applied all the redo generated by the source PDB
                                        before switching roles. As part of managing a switchover, the broker automatically sets
                                        up redo transport from the new source PDB to its designated
                                        target PDB and starts redo apply services on the new target
                                        PDB. PDB failover A role transition in which a designated target PDB is
                                        transitioned to the source PDB role after the source PDB has
                                        failed or has become unreachable. It is recommended that you
                                        perform a failover only when the source PDB is
                                        unavailable.
